Palak Puri Recipe
By: ravikumar
Published: Tuesday, June 19, 2018 - 4:43am

Ingredients




Spinach leaves
Ginger 1/2 inch piece
Cumin powder 1/2 tsp.
Black salt 1/2 teaspoon.
Lemon juice 1/2 teaspoon
Garam masala 1/2 teaspoon.
Wholewheat flour
Oil 2 tablespoons.

Preparation

1 In a bowl add in flour, spinach leaves, ginger, cumin powder, black salt, lemon juice, garam masala and mix it all together to form a dough. 2 Knead the dough and roll small shaped circles 3 Fry them in oil 4 Palak puri is ready to serve.

About

Palak Puriis a healthy Indian Snacks Recipe easy to make.  Palak Puri is the perfect Snacks Recipe for evening tea time. Palak Puri (Spinach Puri Recipe) can be made as a breakfast and an evening snack item in your house. Also best option for kid’s lunch box. How to make Palak Puri? Simple you just need Palak puree, wheat flour, some herbs and spices. This Palak Puri tastes absolutely delicious.
